mapper.insert: insert into mxk_access(id, groupid, appid, createddate, instid) values (#{id}, #{groupId}, #{appId}, current_timestamp, #{instId})
mapper.select:
select apps.id, apps.id as appid, apps.appname, apps.icon, apps.loginurl, apps.protocol, apps.category, apps.description, apps.vendor, apps.vendorurl from mxk_apps apps where apps.instid = #{instId} and not exists ( select 1 from mxk_access p where p.instid = #{instId} and p.groupid = #{groupId} and p.appid = apps.id )
order by apps.sortindex, apps.id
